description: Subscription directory and hiring board for the UAE's Tier 2/3 aerospace and MRO supply chain.
tagline: Sourcing and recruitment for the UAE aerospace sector.
image_alt: Aerospace UAE logo and brand mark

authors.name: Data Team
authors.bio: Maintains the supplier directory, job board, and reference data for Aerospace UAE.

editorial.how_we_test: We verify ICV (In-Country Value) registration and facility capabilities against public registries and direct supplier documentation.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We generate revenue exclusively through paid supplier listings, recruiter job postings, and our subcontractor-matching newsletter.
editorial.how_we_handle_corrections: Errors in directory listings or reference data are corrected immediately upon verification. We do not publish news or editorial commentary.
